# MD Viewer & Converter (Markdown Render)

> A 100% local, browser-based Markdown editor, Mermaid diagram renderer, and high-fidelity document converter (PDF, Word docx, HTML, PNG).

## Key Features & Capabilities
- **Local-First Privacy**: 100% client-side execution in browser. No file or text is uploaded to any server.
- **Mermaid Diagram Rendering**: Renders ```mermaid ``` code blocks into crisp vector diagrams with an 85% modal viewer, pan, zoom, and SVG/PNG exports.
- **Multi-Format Exports**:
  - **PDF Export**: Clean print styling with page-break avoidance (`page-break-inside: avoid`).
  - **Word (.docx)**: Dual width (520px) and height scaling for perfect MS Word A4 layout integration without overflow.
  - **HTML Export**: Standalone clean HTML with styled code boxes and copy-button stripping.
  - **PNG Export**: 2x high-resolution wide image captures.
- **ASCII & Box Drawing Alignment**: Auto-detects `┌─┬─┐` architecture box art and aligns vertical borders using D2Coding/Consolas monospace fonts.
- **Drag & Drop Resizer**: Interactive `#divider` between editor and preview panes with 280px / 360px minimum width limits.
- **Internationalization (i18n)**: Supports English (default), Korean, Japanese, Chinese, and Spanish.
